primary: Q3+Q4 pooled binary F1 from summed TP/FP/FN; OR minus the same tree arm
proposal: fixed original width512/165-feature e150 3-seed mean, threshold0.8/0.4, snap12, minimum19; no retuning
tree_feature_caveat: train-only year-depth dictionary / 168h plateau cap / 80 features; not exact original preprocessing or guaranteed original score
join: canonical station/year/layer/time plus fold; exact full Q3/Q4 key sets required; mismatch emits counts and blocks all performance evaluation; no implicit intersection

bootstrap.cluster: all stations/layers in each calendar 7-day time block; fold boundaries separate clusters
bootstrap.probability: fraction of paired bootstrap pooled-F1 deltas > 0, descriptive not Bayesian probability or fresh-test p-value

risk: report negative fold/station/station-layer/block deltas, worst-block delta and row counts; no post-hoc all-positive or anchor-removal promotion gate
selection: none; all four fixed comparisons reported; root separately decides materialization
